title: Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka II: Mujintou ni Yakusou wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka
justification: AniList 112125 (OVA, 1 episode from 2020-01-29) is AniDB 13829's special S2 Mujintou ni Yakusou o Motomeru no wa Machigatte Iru Darouka (Is It Wrong to Go Searching for Herbs on a Deserted Island?), aired 2020-01-29. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 101167, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 13829, and the special's title matches AniList's in every language. The parent's mapping row places S2 on TVDB 0x4 (2020-01-29) and, with the TMDB row below, on TMDB 62745 S0E3 (2020-01-29).
